text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
My three years with Loves Only You have reached a milestone.
Then, one day—

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text: I'm so looking forward to the hot springs trip~ ♡

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text: Since I'm on a trip, maybe I'll do a stream I wouldn't normally do♪

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text:
Fufu, I hope everyone enjoys it too~♡
Hot spring manju, footbaths, and then, and then—
choice_data_list: (Everyone...)

text_block_list.name: Passionate Teacher
text_block_list.text:
"If you gathered this without her knowing...
You must be troubled about something, right?"
choice_data_list: "Yes. The thing is..."

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
She's eager to livestream even while traveling. But I want her to get some rest on this trip.
I told her I was troubled about what to do.

text_block_list.name: Community Members
text_block_list.text:
""...If that's the case, isn't the answer simple?""
""Yeah... It's obvious."" ""Is it not a simple matter?""

text_block_list.name: Hardworker@Overseas Assignment
text_block_list.text: "Make this trip so fun she completely forgets about streaming!!"

text_block_list.name: Community Members
text_block_list.text:
"Leave the backup to me!"
"Share your travel destination with me. I'll look into it beforehand."

text_block_list.name: Community Members
text_block_list.text: “Alright, let's do this!! We're all gonna make sure she enjoys this hot springs trip to the fullest!!”

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text:
"...Trainer-kun? Traaiiner-kuuun?
Hey, are you listening~~??"
choice_data_list: Yeah, sorry. I was just really looking forward to the hot springs...

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text:
...Trainer-chan? Trainer-chan?
Hey, are you listening~~??
choice_data_list: Yeah, sorry. I was just really looking forward to the hot springs...

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text:
Ehehe♪ That's right! Me too♡
Let's fully enjoy this hot springs trip together♪
choice_data_list: (Ah, I'll make sure you enjoy it to the fullest... I promise!)
(Yeah, I'll make sure they have a blast... without fail!)

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Afterward, we teamed up with the community members
and thoroughly prepared for the hot spring trip.
And finally, the day of the trip arrived—

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text:
Mmm~~~♪
This totally smells like we're at a hot spring~♡

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text: Well then, time for the stream—
choice_data_list: First, how about some hot spring buns?

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text:
Yeah, great idea♪
I actually researched a place beforehand~!
Though it's a super famous shop, so—

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
With that, we headed to a famous onsen manju shop.
Surprisingly, it wasn't very crowded.

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text:
A-Alas? But social media said
there'd be a huge line! Why...?
choice_data_list: (Just like everyone taught me...!)

text_block_list.name: Passionate Teacher
text_block_list.text:
"That place is famous and draws huge lines.
However, it opens at 10:00. The tour buses arrive around 11:00. Which means—"

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text: So it's totally empty at this time♪ Hehehe, how lucky♡

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: "And after that, we followed the itinerary for enjoying the hot springs trip that I'd planned with the comm members—"

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text:
I see, the footbath isn't crowded at lunchtime...!
Come on, let's go together~!

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text:
I didn't know there was a shrine for the performing arts!
I've definitely gotta say a proper prayer♪

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text: Ufufu, fun times really fly by in a flash, don't they?

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text:
I had so much fun that I'm completely worn out.
Let's hurry up and get into the hot springs♪

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: In the bath...

text_block_list.name: Community Members
text_block_list.text:
"Glad to see everything's going well!"
"I knew the shrine of performing arts would make her happy!"
"Alright, got it? Next stop is the arcade!"
choice_data_list: "Leave it to me!"

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text:
Trainer-kun! They have a ping-pong table!
What do you think? Wanna play a match?
choice_data_list: More importantly, there's an arcade on the first floor!

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text:
Trainer-chan! Look, a ping-pong table!
What do you say? Care for a match?
choice_data_list: More importantly, there's an arcade on the first floor!

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text: The arcade? ...Ah, could it be?!
choice_data_list: How about a fighting game instead of table tennis?

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text:
I'm in! Hehehe~♪
I won't pull any punches, okay~!

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text:
Haaah, I'm exhausted~.
Trainer-kun, you really hate losing way too much~.
choice_data_list: Because I'm your trainer, after all.
Because I'm your Trainer, after all.

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text:
Haaah, I'm exhausted~.
Trainer-chan, you really hate losing way too much~.
choice_data_list: Because I'm your trainer, after all.
Because I'm your Trainer, after all.

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text: Ahaha, that might be true♪

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text:
Besides, I got to try out all kinds of combos,
and I had fun too, so it's all good~♡

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text:
Well then, time to head to bed soon!
Not like there's much else to do anyway—

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text: …………Ah, ah, yeah.

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text: Aaaaahhhhh~~~~!?

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text: A-A livestream! A livestreeeeam!?

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text:
"Wh-Wh-Wh-What am I gonna do~~~?!
I completely forgot about ittt~...!"

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text:
U-Umm, the equipment is in my bag, so— 
First, an apology? No, should I write it out first?
choice_data_list: Calm down. There's nothing to worry about. Actually—

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text: All the commu-members... did this for me?
choice_data_list: I've been planning all sorts of things for today, you know.
I've been planning all sorts of things for today.

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text: Aaaah――――

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text: Thank goodneeeessss!!

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text:
"Jeez! You reeeaaally
freaked me out, you know~~!!"
choice_data_list: Sorry, sorry!

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text: Mmh...!

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text:
...No wonder everywhere I went,
nothing but fun things happened to me.

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text:
Aah, they totally got me.
To think I completely forgot about the stream.

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text:
Alright, alright, I give up!
I'll gladly accept everyone's kind words today♡

text_block_list.name: Community Members
text_block_list.text:
"No word from Bridge." "Which means~♪"
"The plan worked!" "All right!!"
"Time to celebrate!" "Yeah! Both of you—"

text_block_list.name: Community Members
text_block_list.text: "Have fun on your trip!"

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text: Thank you, everyone♡

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
It was a moment where I felt
an irreplaceable bond with Loves Only You...
